EC1: History or presence of any clinically significant [OR] disease or disorder
EC2: Any condition or disease that would render the subject unsuitable for the study, place the subject at undue risk or interfere with the ability of the subject to complete the study in the opinion of the investigator
EC3: History of clinically significant [AND] hypersensitivity [OR] or allergic drug reactions
EC4: Any suspicion [OR] or history of alcohol abuse [OR] and/or consumption of other drugs of abuse
EC5: Regular smoker (> 5 cigarettes [OR], > 1 pipeful [OR] or > 1 cigar per day)
EC6: Positive for hepatitis B [OR], hepatitis C [OR] or HIV infection
EC7: Dietary restrictions that would prohibit the consumption of standardized meals
EC8: Participation in an investigational drug or device study within 90 days prior to screening, as calculated from the follow-up from the previous study
